hook: Which tech giant turned $1,000 into the most?

sections.name: hook
sections.text: Which tech giant turned $1,000 into the most?

sections.name: tension
sections.text: Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, Google, Meta and the mystery stock all start with $1,000 in 2015. One of them explodes.

sections.name: call1
sections.text: In 2016, the mystery stock passed Amazon for number one.

sections.name: call2
sections.text: In 2022, Meta fell 70% from its high of the year before.

sections.name: reveal
sections.text: It was Nvidia. Your $1,000 became $350,479, while Meta ended at $8,254.
